mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0) AS documentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_chunk WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}) AS chunkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'SUCCESS') AS completedDocuments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND deleted = 0 AND parse_status = 'FAILED') AS failedDocuments
